summary: Final-year Computer Engineering student and Software Engineering Intern at WSO2. I build reusable, composable, themeable self-service identity components for ThunderID across the React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt and Express SDKs, and contribute to the ThunderID Go backend and the JavaScript SDK monorepo. Outside identity I work on ML models and embedded robotics.

Designed components to be themeable through design tokens (colour, radius, typography, density) so integrators can match their brand without forking.
